description: Complete JATS bodies for the frozen polarity challenge set. Triples, polarity, contexts and quotes are unchanged; only source metadata and byte offsets are remapped.
annotation_policy: A measured absence of a significant effect, including measured ineffectiveness, is no_effect; refutes is reserved for explicit contradiction of a stated or expected claim.
offset_convention: Zero-based half-open UTF-8 bytes. body_* refers to production jats_to_text applied to an article containing ONLY the original JATS body. Each source contains the complete converted body plus one LF, without abstract or references.
